authorization: User requested Q sanity check then autonomous research continuation; previous authorization permits four parallel background tasks.
prerequisite: 5000 Q labels sanity checked, 5 unique problems/25 saved geometries independently rescored exactly; all5000 hard legal
reason: V1 improves heldout ranking modestly but failed registered two-step descent gate; diagnose before long neural training.
case_boundary: Only original fit600/tune200 for all new fits and diagnostic comparisons; original check200 already exposed, never used for new tuning. No dev/test data.

tasks.capacity: Signed linear and quadratic within-case centered ridge, fixed penalty.01; source-only and always-E42 controls. Diagnostic only; no sweep or neural objective adoption.
tasks.stability: 32 fixed-seed case bootstraps of registered nonnegative fit; original selected lambda1 fixed; report quantiles, do not pick a bootstrap winner.
tasks.canonical_view: Recompute position/shape supervision from decoded geometry; eight public terms unchanged; fit exactly one canonical-view positive model with fixed lambda1. Compare tune only.
tasks.descent: Reconstruct existing40-case/160-step raw Loss changes, compare with saved Q/geometry; zero additional postprocessor calls.

candidate_followup: Only if canonical-view tune ranking gains at least.02 and mixed regret reduces>.0005 versus V1 does it warrant a separately registered local direction check. No automatic long training.
outputs: Per-task JSON plus summary report; original database, first-stage results and E98 solver immutable.
